sources.provider: ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 / Element84 public COG

sources.license: ODbL-1.0 (building theme; original per-feature sources retained)
sources.encoding: official vector tile geometry at z14, not full-resolution GeoParquet
sources.geometryAccuracyNote: Encoding grid precision is not surveyed positional accuracy; tiles may simplify original provider geometry.

dataEncoding.mesh: gzip little-endian i16c; positions 0.2m relative to tile center, RGB uint8, indices uint32
dataEncoding.jsonAssets: gzip UTF-8 JSON; original double precision coordinates retained
dataEncoding.sourceIndex: one record per rendered building volume, source floors/use nullable, explicit heightInferenceBasis and original provider provenance
dataEncoding.collisionWaterHoles: waterHoles[i] contains inner rings for water[i]
dataEncoding.streetlightPoints: Same i16c mesh format; index count zero, positions relative to tile center, warm RGB uint8

terrain.method: 150m lower-percentile filtering and smoothing; estimated ground, not surveyed DTM

roofGeometry.orientation: minimum rotated rectangle, with source downslope direction for skillion when supplied
roofGeometry.holeHandling: Each planar face intersects the original polygon including interior rings
roofGeometry.confidence: Planar approximation; original source roof metadata and colors retained, not a measured ornate roof reconstruction

streetlights.coverage: Mapped nodes only, not a complete lighting survey
